description: "Build a topic tree of this session (JSON + Mermaid mindmap) in .resync/trees/"
allowed-tools: Bash(node *) PowerShell(node *)

<!-- Generated by `resync plugin build` from the ReSync prompt library and shared templates. Do not edit by hand. -->

Build a topic tree of this conversation. Number the turns from 1 (each user message and each reply is one turn).
Count the turns carefully.
Reply with ONLY a JSON code block (```json ... ```) holding one root object with this shape:
{ "topic": string, "children": [ ...same shape... ], "turnRange": [firstTurn, lastTurn] }
The root covers the whole conversation. Use 3 to 8 top-level topics, nest at most 3 levels, keep each topic under 8 words.
Only split a topic further if its children cover different turns.
Children must lie within their parent's turnRange.
Top-level ranges must not overlap and must together cover turns 1 to N (the last turn).

Rules for every answer:
- Mark anything inferred or unconfirmed as (assumed).
- Never invent file paths, names, numbers or commands. Write 'unknown' instead.
- Never include API keys, tokens, passwords or personal contact details.
- Exclude the current request itself from the output.

Instead of replying with the JSON, do this:
1. Save the JSON with the Write tool to `.resync/trees/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM.json` in the project root (current local date and time).
2. Validate it and create the Mermaid mindmap by running:
   `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/tree.mjs" ".resync/trees/<that file>.json"`
3. If the script reports errors, fix the JSON file and run it again.
4. Reply with the mindmap it printed (in a ```mermaid block) and the two file paths.
